rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when two things are not connected or associated.

example.jyutping: ni1 loeng5 gin6 si6 mou5 gwaan1 hai6

rows.note: Use this specifically when saying that people are not related by blood or kinship.

example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 mou5 hyut3 jyun4 gwaan1 hai6
